note: Scholar, front view, carrying a red and a brown book pressed to his chest. Head is the brown hair, ears and full beard, bottom y~392 at the beard tip; the blue collar, grey-blue coat and its dark centre strip are torso. Both arms hang at the sides inside wide bell sleeves: upper arm from the shoulder to the elbow y~515 (halfway, the sleeve marks nothing), sleeve forearm to the hem y~585, bare hands emerging below the hems (left x296-364, y578-634, right x594-668, y578-634). The two books and the grey clasp/strap blobs on them (x375-580, y463-600) are equipment; whether the grey blobs are gloved hands holding the books is unclear, I treated them as part of the books because the sleeves clearly end in the peach hands at the sides. Hip is the coat hem y~753; the bare skin below is thigh to the boot tops y~781 (above halfway, so the knee), boot shafts are lower leg to the ankles y~820, boot toes are feet.
